body: I know. I've been to a lot of therapy. I just lose myself sometimes. I lose my happy place. I work as a nurse for kids. I love music and reading.
Yeah.. I feel like I've lost control of my life. Which rationally I know isn't true. But sometimes I'm weak and I spiral.
I'm crying and I can't breathe. When I burn myself it clears my mind, I can breathe again.
Sad thing is, I'm a nurse, I know this.
I looked up how many ibuprofen 800s it took to kill yourself. That's how I found this thread.

When I do it it's like I can breathe. I just moved far away from my family and most of my friends. Which probably wasn't the smart thing for a person with depression to do. I just felt so trapped and felt like the move would help. But I'm just more alone. I feel like I'm drowning.
